Shaped iteration 0124 as one independent review of the proposed WP1 0123 key incorporation and conditional F4 containment.
[Task graph](tasks.json): `review-wp1-key-0124`, reviewer/default/high, 120 minutes and 80 turns, fresh main, no dependencies or staged inputs.

The [author handoff](../benchmark/writing/wp1-key-0123.md) identifies the new incorporation and preserved #587 evidence; these require a separate semantic review.
The task pins the final verification manifest, preserved review records and unchanged authorities, and requires observed checkout identity plus scoped-byte agreement.
It requires separate correctness/grounding decisions for each new ID, an explicit conditional F4 disposition, and Standards/Spec verdicts.
Historical map blocks, general key/trial restrictions, provenance disclosures and benchmark_ready=false remain explicit.
Completed example/cold reviews and F3 probes are not repeated. No session can run LabVIEW.
Detailed review output belongs in `.session/artifacts/wp1-key-review-0124.json`, with its size/hash in the review report; no repository review file is requested.
Verification is `python3 -I benchmark/writing/check_wp1_key_0123.py`, after checker inspection; its result is integrity evidence only.
The shaper has no shell: validation is graph/report readback, with command execution assigned to the reviewer and engine.
[Working memory](../journal/working-memory.md) records the evidence, remaining method gaps and resume instructions. [Startup diagnostics](startup.json) were ok, estimated 14517 tokens.
## What next
Run the reviewer task. CLEAR closes this pinned scope and the next shaper selects a concrete remaining evaluation gap; NOT-CLEAR leads only to correction of named changed leaves.
Preserve unfinished review checks and resume the missing piece; do not replay completed probes or infer readiness from routine merge acceptance. Owner request #532 remains pending without duplicate request or waiting.
